description: Put a file from the agent file store into a connected storage (Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Dropbox, ownCloud). Required: root_id (roots[].id from list_file_accounts), path (from create_file_upload_url, or a WhatsApp attachment path). Optional: folder_id (target folder id; Dropbox/ownCloud: the folder path; empty = root), name (file name there; default: the stored name). Returns the new file with its web link.

path.description: Path in the agent file store, from create_file_upload_url or a WhatsApp attachment

name: upload_remote_file
